issues.title: Iron Chests unintentionally adds non-chest textures from other mods to the chest atlas
issues.body:
## Version Information
`Minecraft: 1.21.1`
`NeoForge: 21.1.54`
`Iron Chests: 16.0.7`

## Report Information
Iron Chests uses a [`DirectoryLister`](https://github.com/progwml6/ironchest/blob/1cdb753b75847d67b928c0ed8d168c2f196c1165/src/generated/resources/assets/minecraft/atlases/chests.json) sprite source to add its chest textures to the chest atlas. The default `DirectorySource` is not namespaced, which means that any texture in the specified directory or subdirectory thereof gets added, regardless of the texture's namespace. Since the `textures/models/` directory is often used for large texture maps used by "entity" models which are rendered by entity renderers or BERs and which are not intended to be stitched to an atlas, this causes the chest atlas to be bloated by these unnecessary textures. In 1.21.1 this can be fixed by using the [`NamespacedDirectoryLister`](https://github.com/neoforged/NeoForge/blob/1.21.x/src/main/java/net/neoforged/neoforge/client/textures/NamespacedDirectoryLister.java) provided by NeoForge since 21.1.29 instead. In earlier versions, this custom sprite source needs to either be implemented manually or the individual textures added by a `SingleFile` sprite source per texture.

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Install Iron Chests together with a mod that adds its own textures in `textures/models/` (i.e. [Modular Force Field Systems](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/mffs))
2. Inspect the chest atlas with vanilla's atlas dump keybind (F3 + S) or [AtlasViewer](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/atlasviewer) (the latter includes information about which resource pack contains the sprite source adding a given texture)

issues.title: Iron Chests not Recognized by a variety of other mod systems (such as Refined Storage)
issues.body:
## Version Information
`Minecraft: 1.20.4`
`NeoForge 20.4.237: `
`Iron Chests: 1.20.4-neoforge-17.3.1.3`

## Report Information
After upgrading from 1.19.2 to 1.20.4, I noticed on my world that an importer for Refined Storage was no longer taking from an Iron Chest container. After going through a lot of isolation steps while trying to provide info for the Refined Storage team (post here: https://github.com/refinedmods/refinedstorage/issues/3731), I found that it seems multiple other mods do not seem to recognize "Iron Chests" containers as storage units (I tried with Diamond Chests, Obsidian Chests, and Iron Chests).

I have tried this with Applied Energistics2, Pipez, and Refined Storage. Importers will work on both Vanilla chests as well as Sophisticated Backpacks, but will not work with an "Iron Chests" container when swapped.

I am *not* using a modpack, everything I do is just swapping out mods in my mods folder. Even when I *only* have Refined Storage and Iron Chest as the mods on a single player world, the issue occurs.

I will add that I did see this issue also happening with Macaw's Furniture, so there's a chance this is a NeoForge problem, but I'm not familiar enough with how things work behind the scenes to know.

I'm happy to provide any more details and would love if someone can confirm if this repro's for them on their machine.

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Install Minecraft NeoForge to version 20.4.237
2. Add to your mods folder Iron Chests 1.20.4-neoforge-17.3.1.3
3. Add to your mods folder your preferred latest 1.20.4 Pipez, Refined Storage, or AE2 mod to test exchanging things. I found Pipez to be the simplest if you are unfamiliar with these mods (https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/pipez/download/5478845). 
4. Start a single player survival world

-If using pipez-
5. Give yourself two Iron Chests
6. Place the Iron Chests
7. Try to connect a universal cable between the Iron Chests
8. Be sure to use the Pipez wrench to import from one chest to the other
9. Observe no items transfer (Observe trying this with two vanilla chests to confirm your setup is working there)

-If using AE2/Refined Storage-
5. Give yourself an Iron Chest
6. Create a functioning network with either of the mods
7. Try to use an importer to connect to the Iron Chest
8. Observe no items transfer into the system (Observe trying this with a vanilla chest to confirm your setup is working)

## Forge Log
https://pastebin.com/jUpFTgjr

(Note this log was on my last run which had JEI, Applied Energistics 2, and Iron Chests, I can get logs of just Iron Chests and Refined Storage if that would help. I added JEI to help setup AE2 quickly)

issues.body:
## Version Information
`Minecraft: 1.18.2`
`Forge: 40.2.0`
`Iron Chests: 13.2.11`

## Report Information
When breaking chests (they don't have a specified tool tag to break : #279) and they will reappear momentarily then break on their own.
Also vein-mining doesn't seem to work on them

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Place a chest (from the mod)
2. Try to break it
3. The bug happens 

## Forge Log
[is this it?](https://gist.github.com/INooBTooMuch/59ce812b47c96d6113c901c65867951e)

issues.body:
<!--- We do not take bug reports for outdated builds of Minecraft, or unofficial builds. -->

## Version Information
`Minecraft: 1.15.2`
`Forge: 31.2.9`
`Iron Chests: 10.0.3`

## Report Information
<!-- Please provide a detailed description of the issue -->

The `Create` mod checks whether block can be used as storage based on [forge capability system](https://github.com/Creators-of-Create/Create/blob/mc1.15/dev/src/main/java/com/simibubi/create/content/contraptions/components/structureMovement/MountedStorage.java#L125-L127).

However, the iron chest did not implement this method correctly.

Some other mod (like refined relocation2) do have [implemented](https://github.com/blay09/RefinedRelocation2/blob/1.15.x/src/main/java/net/blay09/mods/refinedrelocation/tile/SortingChestTileEntity.java#L215-L217) this correctly so it just work

## Steps to Reproduce
<!-- Please try to provide a way to reproduce the bug reported -->
1. Install both `iron chest` and `create` and `refined relocation2`.
2. attach vanilla chest and chest from both of them to the create structure and draw item from them.

### Expect
`Create` draws item from all of them

### Actual
`Create`  draws item only from vanilla chest and `refined relocation2` chest

## Crash Log

Opening an upgraded shulker box (iron, gold or diamond) sometimes makes the player inventory disappear, including equipped items. Relogging makes the items reappear again, as does opening the Baubles menu. Despite this, while the items are "disappeared" their effects no longer apply (for example: the Boots of the Traveller no longer provide a speed buff), so they are really gone, and it's not just a visual glitch.

## Steps to Reproduce
Place an upgraded shulker box in the world, and open it (only work sometimes). It's possible this is some sort of mod conflict, possibly with Quark, since I noticed that the inventory preview when mousing over an upgraded shulker box in your inventory still only shows 27 slots. This may be unrelated, however.

## Crash Log
It's called a "crash log" in the document, but it didn't actually crash: 
[Shulker Box Crash Log.txt](https://github.com/progwml6/ironchest/files/4235673/Shulker.Box.Crash.Log.txt)

## Forge Log
No idea what this is, or how to find it.

While this glitch is somewhat inconsistent, it's still fairly easy for me to repeat, should additional information be required.

## Version Information
`Minecraft: `1.12.2

## Report Information
When I load my old test world that has a refined relocation iron chest, the server shuts down and crashes on world loadup and render

install iron chest 7.0.67.844 and refined relocation 4.2.35 on forge

issues.title: Disappearing inventories
issues.body:
Hi,
The disappearing inventory issue #142 still persists in the latest version ironchest-1.12.2-7.0.55.839
Issue also reported here https://github.com/SlimeKnights/TinkersConstruct/issues/3670

Using:
TConstruct-1.12.2-2.12.0.113
Mantle-1.12-1.3.3.39
forge-1.12.2-14.23.5.2768
ironchest-1.12.2-7.0.55.839

The issue is the same as before. Any Ironchest in a chunk containing smeltery controller has an inventory that disappears until it's updated.
Strangely enough, the issue is also present in Immersive Engineering with the wooden crate, but so far no issues detected in my other mods that add chests and crates.

It can be reliably reproduced with the above setup in SP and MP, any size smeltery (although I'm using 7x7 currently). 
It seems to take 7-10 seconds to disappear after updating the inventory.
It seems as though the actual controller has to be in the same chunk as an ironchest. Seared blocks/tanks that happen to overlap into other chunks don't effect ironchests in those chunks.

issues.title: Chest contents disappear when a Tinkers Construct Smeltery is in the same chunk
issues.body:
When a chest from the Iron Chests mod is in the same chunk as a smeltery, the contents of the chest sometimes disappear when looking into it.
The contents only disappear visually. Putting items in the chest still works and taking items out too.

It doesn't seem to be just a rendering bug, because when I put items in the "empty" chest, the get put in the first slot. If the chest is empty and I put items in, they will be put back in my inventory when I close the chest.

I had the bug on IronChests version 1.12.2-7.0.46.831, playing the FTB Continuum Modpack without any changes to configs or mods.

I found the workaround on this link: https://forum.feed-the-beast.com/threads/iron-chest-inventory-disappears.291609/

over this link: https://forum.feed-the-beast.com/threads/iron-chest-reinforced-crate-contents-vanish-and-reappear.283883/

issues.title: TESR registrations for null te class
issues.body:
https://github.com/progwml6/ironchest/blob/1.12/src/main/java/cpw/mods/ironchest/client/ClientProxy.java#L35 registers tesrs with a null te class from both loops where the type is VANILLA. This doesn't make sense and should normally crash if FML validated the inputs properly.

Currently this bug has no effect I am aware of, it just pollutes the tesr map with null keyed entries.

issues.title: Suggestion - Make chest/shulker box interface show chest type
issues.body:
When opening a vanilla chest or shulker box, at the top of the interface it will usually say the name of the block, like "Chest" or "Shulker Box". However, the storage blocks from this mod do not have this. This has been the case as long as this mod has existed, but it would be nice if it was tweaked. If the interface said "[material] Chest", or "[material] Shulker Box" at the top of the interface, it would be a very nice tweak for consistency/immersion.

If this is not possible, can someone please explain why? Otherwise it would be super cool if it could be done!

issues.title: [1.12.2] Chest(s) may be misreporting capacity
issues.body:
Hi folks,

Playing Enigmatica 2, v1.49. I'm outputting with CoFH's Impulse ducts to diamond chests and the chests won't fill past the half way point. That is, the diamond chest offers a 12 x 9 inventory space. The ducts will fill up to and including the 6th column of the 5th row, then won't insert any more. It's happening both furnace to chest and chest to chest.

I reported to CoFH and KingLemming replied that this would only happen if the chest was misreporting its capacity.

MC 1.12.2
Forge 14.23.4.2751
CoFH Core 4.6.1.22
TDynamics 2.5.3.16
TExpansion 5.5.2.36
TFoundation 2.6.1.22
Iron Chest 7.0.51 build 836

issues.title: Disappearing Issue
issues.body:
Hello,

I think this is just a multiplayer issue, so I'm not sure you can do anything about it, but I'd be a crappy server owner if I didn't report it!

Basically, sometimes the contents of Iron Chests will vanish - The items will still be there but they're inaccessible until you close and re-open the chest. I tried to make a GIF of it, but it only happens sometimes, and happens more often when accessed via a Tinkers' Crafting Station. So far I've seen it happen on both Diamond and Gold chests.

issues.title: IronChests and CarryOn issues
issues.body:
Hi! I currently having some issues using this mod and [CarryOn](https://minecraft.curseforge.com/projects/carry-on).

Basically, carrying an Iron Chest with items inside always faces west when leaving it on ground.

I reported the issue on CarryOn side (https://github.com/Tschipp/CarryOn/issues/97), but the author closed this as `wontfix` because:

> This is a Problem that occurs when Blocks store their rotation in NBT and not in BlockStates. The same happens with Machines from AE2. Sadly there's nothing I can do about that.

Is there something you can do to remediate this? Thanks in advance!

issues.title: Improve how shulker boxes are dropped
issues.body: The way vanilla shulker boxes are dropped is pretty awful. Basically every mod with any sort of block breaker needs to special-case them to avoid dupe bugs. Our shulker boxes currently copy that flaw, meaning any such mod currently needs to special case us as well. To fix this, we should move the drop logic to getDrops where it belongs, instead of messing with breakBlock and dropBlockAsItemWithChance.

issues.title: IronChests doesnt "pick up" items registred in oredict via CraftTweaker
issues.body:
I have [this CraftTweaker script](https://gist.github.com/vpontin/5a27f2f5809d7dd9d270879f1101b8f3) which adds my custom cooper ingot in ingotCooper oredict, but ironchests doesnt seems to recognize it in cooper-based recipes.

After talking in @jaredlll08 's Discord server they said it's somewhat ironchest fault:

> jared points to https://github.com/progwml6/ironchest/blob/1.12/src/main/resources/assets/ironchest/recipes/chest/copper/vanilla_copper_chest.json#L4

> KnightMiner: Yeah, that functions if you have mods registering oredict before recipes, though officially the proper way to handle oredict recipes is to always register them and just have them do nothing of the oredict is missing.

Is possible to make ironchests propely support items parsed in oredict by craftweaker? Thanks in advance!

issues.title: Use wood planks instead of glass in chest upgrade recipes
issues.body:
This is a feeler related to indemnity83/irontanks#50 where there is a recipe conflict between Iron Tanks and Iron Chest. 

I'm curious if there is any appetite for a PR which would adjust the recipe for a couple of the chest upgrades to use wood planks (or nothing) in place of glass?

Specifically the Copper to Iron Upgrade, Silver to Gold Upgrade & Gold to Diamond Upgrades

It would have to be a config option for any current release, but could potentially become default behavior on the next major release?

issues.title: 1.12.2 Silver Shulker Box doesn't exist anymore

issues.title: [Suggestion] Dynamic Shulker Box Models.
issues.body:
While I was looking at a texture atlas using Mezz's TextureDump mod and I noticed that the size for Iron Chests textures were bigger than Minecraft's.
I was thinking that models for the different shulker boxes could be baked dynamically, similarly to either Tinkers' Construct or Chisel and Bits. It could help with the size of the texture atlas.
This won't really affect smaller modpacks but it will help larger ones.

- Copper to Silver
- Silver to Gold
- Copper to Iron
- Diamond to Crystal
- Diamond to Obsidian

issues.title: Iron Shulker Boxes
issues.body:
Shulker boxes offer some unique utility that chests don't. They keep their inventories, making them work as backpacks. They can be placed by dispensers and broken by pistons, making them useful in sorting systems and other redstone applications.
Unfortunately, by modded Minecraft standards, they're tiny. With that in mind, I recommend a mod that allows you to upgrade them into larger shulker boxes.

When this mod is ported to 1.11, I recommend adding upgraded versions of the shulker box. They can use the same recipes, and interact with the same upgrades. They would have the mechanics of a shulker box, but with an expanded inventory.

issues.title: Make DirtChest more useful
issues.body:
I suspect the DirtChest9000 was added as a joke, but there are genuinely many cases where a single-stack inventory would be really handy.  This almost serves that need but sadly it's restricted to dirt only.

1. It would be nice if the DirtChest (or perhaps a separate chest block) would accept a single stack of any item.

2. In 1.10.2-7.0.11.797 at least, the book that comes with the DirtChest9000 is broken -- it only displays the first word on each page.

issues.title: Chest orientation
issues.body:
Hello.

I just want to report a little issue in this mod.
When I load a map, occasionally, some chests do not face the good direction.
Supposing I place a chest facing south, it may later be loaded facing north, as shown in the screenshot.
When I quit the game and come back, the chests faces the good direction properly again.

The issue does not always occur. The building in the screenshot is split into 2 chunks, the border is in the middle.
As you can see it only occurs in the left chunk. The focused chest **(2)** and in the one close to the glowstone on the left **(1)** are supposed to face the same direction as the chest on the right **(3)**.

Mod version: 7.0.11 build 797
MC version: 1.10.2, but occurs in 1.8.9 as well
Other configuration: Java 1.8.0 x64, Forge 12.18, Optifine 1.10.2 (occurs without) and a few more mods.

Not important, but a little boring :)

Hope it helps!

issues.title: Gold Chest placed next to AE2 Import Bus has smaller inventory
issues.body:
When placing a Gold Chest from IronChests 6.0.46.732 next to an Import Bus from 
AE2 rv1-alpha-47, the inventory of the Gold Chest is cut down to the size of an Iron Chest / Large Chest. If the chest is moved to there using a Dolly from Jabba, any items in the bottom 1/3 of the Gold Chest are deleted since the slots are missing.
http://tinypic.com/m/i5xel2/3 http://tinypic.com/m/i5xel3/3
http://ae2.ae-mod.info/Tracker/0873/
